limits: Names resolved with recorded search precedence; this is not ABI/symbol/version validation, dlopen execution, device health, or a full runtime dependency certification.
Only ELF dynamic metadata is freshly read; stage/collective full-file hashes are previous prep evidence and still require launch byte checks.
DT_NEEDED excludes dynamically constructed dlopen plugin names (including SYCL/Level Zero backends). Hardware-capability alternatives and interposition/load-order effects are not executed.
RPATH inheritance is tracked per traversal; object selection remains static candidate resolution, not proof of the dynamic loader namespace.
